t: Year 1 Phonics Check
b: Australian Government, on the Literacy Hub
m: Year 1 (usually Term 3), Year 2 and older struggling readers
s: Screening Students' decoding skills across words of increasing complexity, using real words and pseudowords. Students are categorised as fluent decoders (28 to 40), developing decoders (20 to 27) or struggling decoders (0 to 19). Identifying decoding strengths and instructional needs for individual students, classes and year levels, identifying students who might need phonics intervention, and tracking the effectiveness of phonics instruction over time. assessment tool screener

t: Year 1 Number Check
b: Australian Government, on the Mathematics Hub
